_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/app/site.ts; `slug` also names the KV namespace titles (terraform `repo`) and the secret project; `domain` is the root domain tenants hang off (BASE_DOMAIN; stage's is `stage.<domain>`) and `subdomain` the workers.dev placeholder, both placeholders because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in any link to this repository.
